description: 1200+ DevOps Bash Scripts - AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, APIs, SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Hive, Impala, Kafka, Hadoop, Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab, BitBucket, Azure DevOps, TeamCity, Spotify, MP3, LDAP, Code/Build Linting, pkg mgmt for Linux, Mac, Python, Perl, Ruby, NodeJS, Golang, Advanced dotfiles: .bashrc, .vimrc, .gitconfig, .screenrc, tmux..

summary.one_liner: A large personal collection of over 1200 DevOps shell scripts plus advanced dotfiles and Bash environment configs for cloud, Kubernetes, databases, big data, CI/CD and media tasks.
summary.what_it_does: Provides hundreds of Bash scripts organized by technology, including AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Docker, databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite), Kafka/Hadoop/Hive, and CI systems such as Jenkins and GitHub Actions. It includes dotfiles (.bashrc, .bash.d/*.sh, .vimrc, .gitconfig, .screenrc, .tmux.conf) and a scripting library (lib/) used by other repos. It has API helper scripts that handle authentication for popular services so queries can be made by supplying an endpoint path. Installation scripts in install/ fetch tools such as AWS CLI, Terraform, kubectl and Helm, and a make target installs OS package dependencies. Other areas cover Linux and Mac utilities (disk speed tests, duplicate file finders, SSL cert checks), Mac AppleScript automation, Spotify API scripts, and media tools.
use_cases: bootstrap a shell environment with advanced bash and dotfile configs
install DevOps CLIs like AWS CLI, Terraform, kubectl and Helm
query cloud and CI APIs from the command line with auto-handled tokens
run quick PostgreSQL or MySQL sandboxes in Docker
audit AWS accounts, CloudTrail and IAM settings
find duplicate files or verify SSL certificates on Linux or Mac
manage Spotify playlists via API scripts
notable: Over 1200 scripts organized by technology across cloud, databases, big data and CI
Advanced .bashrc and .bash.d/ library with automatic GPG and SSH agent handling
API scripts that handle authentication so you only supply the endpoint path
lib/ scripting and CI-detection library shared across many other repos
One-touch Docker sandboxes for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite
caveats: The curl-to-shell quick setup is a remote install that modifies shell profiles and symlinks dotfiles into $HOME
Scripts are tailored to the author's workflows and many target Linux distributions and Mac specifically; some are Mac-only
Quick setup link in the README is truncated, so the exact bootstrap URL is not shown
